newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia firms after ABN AMRO's 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia firms after ABN AMRO's 'buy'.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt opened a shade firmer on Monday following a 'buy' recommendation by ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett.
Zalakeramia shares opened at 9,000 forints, up from Friday's close of 8,960 forints. At 1107 GMT Zalakeramia shares traded at 8,985 forints.

"Currently trading at a discount to its tile-making peers, Zalakeramia's share price does not reflect the very positive medium- and long-term outlook for the stock," Tommy Erdei, ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett's Budapest-based analyst said in a report.
"We strongly believe that these acquisitions will add value within two years," Erdei said.
Zalakeramia announced acquisitions plans in January and will hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on February 12 to discuss issues related to its planned new acquisitions.

"The company's investment projects are expected to make a return on invested capital of 100 percent within three years and management has already demonstrated its ability to realise its investment objectives," Erdei added.
